verdict.rationale: Security updates for older major versions are a fair question for a widely used UI library, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no security-patch backport policy, LTS line, or support window for older React majors. React Compiler supporting React 17 and 18 is tooling compatibility, not security maintenance, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can continue receiving security updates for an older major version while I plan my migration
